column1: Master of Precision: Henry Leland|1966|0|0|1932|7.5,8,8.5,8,7.5,9,10,8,7,7|Ottilie M. Leland and Minnie Dubbs Millbrook|Precision manufacture, interchangeable parts and quality standards fit the profile directly. Family access supplies detail but limits independence; not a machinist training manual. Source highlights and publisher account indicate distinct manufacturing and organizational lessons; D=7.5 remains a description-based estimate. International influence of production methods makes T11=0. https://wsupress.wayne.edu/9780814326657/ confirms 1966 origin, 1932 life endpoint and family-authored provenance; current publisher credits Wilfred's originating manuscript, completed by Ottilie. Historical catalog credits Ottilie and Millbrook: https://books.google.mn/books?id=_fyxkxwu74sC .

Isambard Kingdom Brunel: The Definitive Biography of The Engineer, Visionary, and Great Briton|1957|0|0|1859|8,8,8,8,8,9,10,9,8.5,8|L. T. C. Rolt|Bridges, railways and steamships supply multiple engineering and project-management cases; biography exception applies. Family archives and continued specialist attention support authority, not infallibility. Source nomination and museum specialist review support D=8 provisionally through varied projects rather than length alone. https://www.museumsassociation.org/museums-journal/reviews/2024/10/on-my-bookshelf-isambard-kingdom-brunel-by-ltc-rolt/ and https://obnb.uk/p9660014-isambard-kingdom-brunel-a-biography confirm 1957. Global engineering implications mean T11=0; endpoint 1859.

Endless Frontier: Vannevar Bush, Engineer of the American Century|1997|10|0|1974|8,9,8.5,8,7.5,9,10,8.5,8,8|G. Pascal Zachary|Connects computing, industrial research, wartime organization and public science funding. US institutional history warrants T11, while scientific organization is central and war is an application, T12=0. Publisher account and source nomination support distinct technical and organizational cases; D=7.5 remains low-confidence without full text. https://mitpress.mit.edu/9780262740227/endless-frontier/ and https://search.worldcat.org/title/36521020 confirm original 1997, not 1999 reprint. Endpoint 1974 follows Bush's life.

The Bugatti Story|1966|0|0|1947|6.5,6.5,6.5,6.5,6,8,8,7,5.5,5.5|L’Ebe Bugatti|Family memoir of vehicle design and manufacture, with transferable production and invention detail. Not a technical repair reference. Contemporary review reports substantial detail but difficult prose; D=6 estimates mixed learning yield, while N/P separately reflect readability. Family perspective limits E. Original French 1966 and English 1967 verified at https://www.thef1store.com/contents/en-us/p2618.html and https://www.kirkusreviews.com/book-reviews/a/lebe-bugatti/the-bugatti-story/ . The latter mistakenly calls the author a son; she was the daughter. End 1947 is Ettore's death.

Against the Odds: An Autobiography by James Dyson|1997|0|0|1997|6.5,8,8.5,8,7.5,8.5,10,8.5,7.5,7|James Dyson|Prototype iteration, intellectual property, manufacturing and routes to market connect engineering decisions to commercialization. First-person success narrative limits causal generalization; practical cases still provide payload. D=7.5 is a provisional estimate from source and catalog description, not a full-text audit. https://books.google.com/books/about/Against_the_Odds.html?id=Mq5lAgAACAAJ and https://obnb.uk/p10733640-against-the-odds-an-autobiography verify 1997 and nonfiction identity despite an erroneous generic fiction tag in Google metadata. Endpoint 1997 approximate.

Invention: A Life|2021|0|0|2021|6.5,8.5,8.5,8,7.5,8.5,10,8.5,7.5,7|James Dyson|A later distinct memoir, not a retitled edition of Against the Odds. Explains iterative product design, company building and technical education across a longer career. Founder self-presentation limits E; multiple product cases support a provisional D=7.5 but need full-text confirmation. https://www.simonandschuster.com/books/Invention/James-Dyson/9781982188443 and https://search.worldcat.org/title/1240575912 confirm 2021. Endpoint 2021 approximate. Not the Norbert Wiener book with the same short title.

I Invented the Modern Age: The Rise of Henry Ford|2013|0|0|1927|8,8,8,8,7.5,9,9.5,8,8,8|Richard Snow|Model T development and production scaling connect product design, work organization and mass markets. International industrial effects mean T11=0 despite US narrative. Source nomination and publisher description support distinct manufacturing cases, with biographical material lowering estimated D to 7.5. https://www.simonandschuster.com/books/I-Invented-the-Modern-Age/Richard-Snow/9781451645590 verifies 2013. Endpoint 1927 is an approximate boundary for the central Model T era, not Ford's entire life; low confidence in endpoint.

Nuts!: Southwest Airlines' Crazy Recipe for Business and Personal Success|1996|10|0|1996|6.5,7.5,8,7,7,8,8,8,7.5,7|Kevin Freiberg and Jackie Freiberg|Airline cost structure, utilization and organization provide operations lessons, not a flight-training curriculum. Long access supports detail but consultants' celebratory framing limits independence. Source and publisher contents suggest useful practices mixed with culture anecdotes; D=7 provisional. US domestic airline focus warrants T11. https://books.google.com/books/about/Nuts.html?id=L7sVAQAAMAAJ confirms 1996. Endpoint 1996 approximate.

Last Train to Paradise: Henry Flagler and the Spectacular Rise and Fall of the Railroad that Crossed an Ocean|2002|10|0|1935|7.5,7,7,7,7.5,8.5,8.5,7.5,8,7.5|Les Standiford|Rail construction, capital commitment and exposure to extreme conditions offer project and risk lessons. Florida-focused history incurs T11; infrastructure, not war or finance alone, is central. Source and catalog description indicate varied construction and failure cases; D=7.5 is provisional and includes narrative biographical material. https://search.worldcat.org/title/47930616 confirms 2002 and endpoint 1935 destruction. No technical training exclusion.

International industrial influence means T11=0; neither finance nor politics dominates. https://books.google.com/books/about/Enzo_Ferrari.html?hl=en&id=be8JAQAAMAAJ and https://search.worldcat.org/title/Enzo-Ferrari-%3A-the-man-the-cars-the-races-the-machine/oclc/22624990 confirm original 1991 and earlier subtitle. End 1988 is Ferrari's death.
